# MentalFoodChain

> A science-backed resource for intermittent fasting, ketogenic diets, and evidence-based nutrition strategies for health optimization.

MentalFoodChain provides comprehensive guides and research on fasting protocols, ketogenic nutrition, and metabolic health across multiple languages including English and German. The site combines practical diet frameworks with nutritional science to help users understand dietary approaches like intermittent fasting and keto.

## Key Topics

- Intermittent Fasting
- Keto Diet
- Ketogenic Nutrition
- MCT Oil
- Coconut Oil
- Weight Loss
- Fasting Protocols
- Nutrition Science
- Eat-Stop-Eat
- Lectins
- Health Guides
- Metabolic Health
- Diet PDFs
- Evidence-Based Nutrition

## Core Resources

- [MentalFoodChain | Fasting, Keto, and Science-Backed Health](https://www.mentalfoodchain.com/): English homepage covering intermittent fasting, keto diet, and science-backed nutrition
- [MentalFoodChain | Gesundheit. Wissenschaftlich fundiert.](https://www.mentalfoodchain.com/de/): German language homepage for MentalFoodChain covering Intervallfasten and ketogenic nutrition
